What a bite does

Similar delayed-recognition risk to other kraits: bite is frequently painless, delaying treatment even though paralysis progresses over hours. Also called Taiwanese krait or Chinese krait.

Antivenom source. Taiwan/China.

Name and taxonomy. 'Taiwanese krait' is the same species (merged).

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
